items.stem: Claude extracts an invoice total but marks the figure as low confidence because the scan was faint. What should happen?

options.text: Route it to a human to verify before any payment action
options.rationale: Correct: low-confidence financial data must be checked, not auto-processed.

options.text: Use the figure anyway since Claude produced a value
options.rationale: A low-confidence value may be wrong and must not drive payment.

options.text: Round the figure to the nearest hundred
options.rationale: Rounding an uncertain value does not make it correct.
Discarding a valid document is disproportionate; it needs review, not deletion.

items.explanation: Correct: low-confidence financial data must be checked, not auto-processed.

items.stem: Which TWO properties keep a document-intake scenario safe to retry? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Idempotency so a document is not processed twice
options.rationale: Correct: idempotency prevents duplicate filing or actions on retry.

options.text: Error handling that stops a failed document mid-flow
options.rationale: Correct: failed documents must not be half-processed and forgotten.

options.text: Processing the newest document first regardless of errors
options.rationale: Order of processing does not address retry safety.

options.text: Deleting the source file immediately on receipt
options.rationale: Deleting the source removes the ability to reprocess or audit.

items.explanation: Correct: idempotency prevents duplicate filing or actions on retry.

items.stem: What should govern how long processed documents are kept?

options.text: A defined retention policy appropriate to the document type
options.rationale: Correct: retention must be deliberate and matched to the data and obligations.

options.text: Keeping everything forever in case it is needed
options.rationale: Indefinite retention of documents increases risk and cost.

options.text: Deleting everything after processing to save space
options.rationale: Premature deletion can breach obligations and lose audit trails.

options.text: Whatever Google Drive's default happens to be
options.rationale: Relying on an unexamined default is not a retention decision.

items.explanation: Correct: retention must be deliberate and matched to the data and obligations.
